OpenAI has decided to discontinue its plans for implementing recycled water cooling at its Sydney data center due to regulatory hurdles that hindered the necessary pipeline's construction. This significant development will benefit approximately 180 seasonal residents and ITBP personnel stationed there. The electrification project, costing rupees 21 crore, spans sixty-one kilometers and includes twelve villages. Power lines have been laid up to Rasgadi, with Bugdiyar also slated for electrification shortly. Patrick Mahomes, Brittany Mahomes' $5 million act builds lasting Texas legacy. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' recent $5 million donation to Texas Tech marks a transformative moment for the university's football facilities. This substantial amount amplifies the fundraising efforts and ensures naming rights for prominent sections of the new complex. With Patrick's rich history at Texas Tech, their generosity underscores a lasting commitment to elevating the school's athletic programs to new heights.
